title: Original tour of Barcelona city centre
text: Very nice experience that makes you discover really special corners of the city and at the same time entertains the group. We chose the most difficult treasure hunt with so many puzzles to solve with a lot of logic, it was not at all obvious so it was also a good challenge between all of us to those who came first to the solution.
author: rominabK3846MX

title: A fun activity
text:
A great time to spend with the family. Riddles that are neither too easy nor too complicated. A (re)discovery of Barcelona in a fun and informative way.
We will repeat this experience in other cities.
author: Passport50994404158

title: Very representative of my city
text: I’m born and grown in Barcelona but Moved years ofi. This game was very representative of the history of the city and I also enjoyed playing and explaining my kids how was the living in the past and in my times. It was really fun and interesting.
author: juditroga

title: Very good experience!
text:
We have done the activity "Discover the secret of Cerdá" as a couple and we loved it!
It has been a lot of fun touring the city and solving the puzzles to discover the mystery. Super experience!!
author: Destination535351

title: Seeing with new eyes!
text: It was a great way to explore the city! We loved running around and looking for clues all while noticing things that we would not have.
author: micahb257

title: Fun!
text: We loved this game which allowed us to discover or re-discover certain emblematic buildings of Barcelona. The welcome was perfect.
author: Dreamer670893

title: Perfect !
text:
Perfect. Thank you so much. 
The game was fun and allowed us to discover other places in Barcelona.
I recommend. The difficulty level, for my, was easy, but I'm used to playing this kind of game.
author: X4110HClaurac

title: Great experience!
text:
Well designed, well executed and super fun game. We did it as a family and really enjoyed it!
Not too difficult, I recommend!
author: sol_nef356

title: Great activity with the kids!
text: Top activity. Which allows you to explore a little part of Bcn with the children in a fun and entertaining way for them! The puzzles are neither too simple nor too complicated (the children are 5, 8 and 12 years old). We recommend!
author: Z7388PDstephanied

title: Very entertaining and a good walk through the city center
text: The enigmas are very ingenious, some easier and others more complicated, but very good. It allows you to notice things about the city that you may not have noticed.
author: 597roserm
